info.title: Coffee Management API - payment settlement foundation
info.description: Auth/catalog/orders plus atomic cash settlement and provider-neutral external verification/reconciliation. External adapter unconfigured by default (503); fake exists only in tests. No real KHQR/bank callbacks, Inventory, refund or split payment.

post.description: Public login. Role determined by database. Five requests/minute per normalized email+IP and thirty/minute per IP, including success/invalid input. Generic 401 for invalid, inactive, unassigned or unrecognized-role identity. Email/device_name trimmed; email lowercased; password not trimmed. Unknown top-level request fields rejected.

post.summary: Atomically create an unpaid pending order
post.description: All active staff with process-pos. USD server prices, zero discount/tax, inventory_tracked=false. New actor/key =201; same semantic cart =200 original immutable result even after catalog changes; changed cart =409. Canonical hash sorts distinct product IDs/quantities; no names/prices/secrets in intent hash. No payment or inventory I/O.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: One case-sensitive opaque key per actor/cart; no body transport or comma-combined header

200.description: Original order on same semantic replay

409.description: Idempotency-Key already used by actor for different intent

422.description: Invalid cart/header or unavailable authoritative catalog; errors.idempotency_key for header errors

get.summary: Read own or authorized shop history
get.description: Cashier own; manager/admin shop. Fixed created_at DESC/id DESC. No owner override or business-day filtering. Unknown parameters rejected; items/creator eager-loaded.

schema.description: Valid absolute ISO timestamp with explicit offset <=14 hours; UTC conversion, optional fractional precision; no calendar-day interpretation
Valid absolute ISO timestamp with explicit offset <=14 hours; UTC conversion, optional fractional precision; no calendar-day interpretation

422.description: Invalid/unknown query, calendar/offset or reversed boundaries

get.description: Cashier own only; manager/admin shop. Scope query before lookup plus OrderPolicy. Numeric IDs are not URI keys; hidden/missing order same404. No mutation/payment/receipt operations.

post.summary: Authorize and atomically accept cash settlement
post.description: Cashier own; manager/admin shop. Only tender intent; server USD amount/change/status/owner. Order then Payment locks. Same key/tender replay precedes paid check; distinct key cannot settle paid/active external order. No stock I/O.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: One actor-authorized, per-order case-sensitive payment key. Same intent replay 200; changed method/tender 409.

201.description: First confirmed cash payment; order paid

403.description: Inactive/unassigned/unknown role, missing staff ability or action permission

404.description: Missing/hidden order or payment outside scoped order

409.description: Paid/ineligible order, unresolved active attempt or changed key intent

post.summary: Persist external attempt before provider I/O
post.description: Cashier own; manager/admin shop. No provider contract approved: production adapter returns 503 before creating intent. With approved adapter: persist initiated correlation/expected facts and active pointer, commit, then I/O outside all transactions; pending QR is not paid, timeout uncertain. Replay returns stored state without resending initiation.

get.description: Cashier own; manager/admin shop. Fixed created_at DESC/id DESC, bounded pages, strict filters. No keys, proof payload, merchant/private authority or credentials serialized.

post.summary: Query trusted provider evidence and apply once
post.description: Authorized own/shop POS staff. Empty body; never accepts client transaction/status proof. Current adapter default 503. Verify outside transactions, then lock Order/Payment. Exact provider/merchant/correlation/order/amount/currency matching and global transaction uniqueness. Mismatch/late/second evidence retained and flagged; no double acceptance. Manual recovery is not a durable worker or public callback contract.
